subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: V16 LDM with base in the list adds the writeback to the loaded value (real bug, small repro)
body:
While chasing k_fvec_loop I found a V16 LDM bug with base-in-list, independent of that kernel:

  ldm r7,{r2,r3,r7}      @ cf8c, no writeback (llvm-objdump prints no !)
  memory r7+0/4/8 = 11111111 / 22222222 / aaaaaaaa
  expected r7 = aaaaaaaa; got aaaaaab6 = aaaaaaaa + 12.

With 33333333 got 3333333f = +12. So something adds 4*n (the writeback amount) to the **loaded** r7 even though W=0; if W=1 the code at emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c:242 also uses the loaded c->r[rn] rather than the original base, so writeback would be wrong too. Repro: tests/emu/asm/ldm.s style (I can put it in tests/emu/asm if useful). This is not the k_fvec_loop mismatch (r7 is not used after that ldm there), but worth fixing before DONE. k_v15_extend remains the other open item. F17/V14 patches are applied and green.
